about: The war mode's radio script, the source for every voice file. tools/voice/build.py reads it. Rules (docs/WARFARE-PLAN.md section 7.1): the enemy is never named; the defenders are the pilots of both banks; no real figure is spoken until a source for it is in the plan. It also carries The Interior's voices and lines (group interior and its films, docs/campaign/interior/BIBLE.md 5), whose own rules are BIBLE.md 0: ustedes to the players and usted between characters, spelled numbers allowed and never a digit. This file is part of the Paraguayan Drone Combat Simulator, licensed GPLv3 or later.

crest.role: CREST, Crest Control: the commander. Orders, the plant, the frame (docs/campaign/BIBLE.md 5.2).

en.reference: This is Crest Control. All pilots, listen up. We hold this dam, or the lights go out on both banks. Keep your eyes on the water and your fingers on the sticks.

es.reference: Aquí Control Cresta. Todos los pilotos, atentos. Esta represa se sostiene, o se apagan las luces en las dos márgenes. Ojos en el agua y dedos en los sticks.

mirador.role: MIRADOR: intel on the observation post at the shore. What is coming, from where.

en.reference: Mirador on the net. East shore is quiet, the scope is clean to the north. I will call every contact by its landmark, then its kind, then where it is going.

es.reference: Mirador en la red. La costa este está tranquila, el radar está limpio hacia el norte. Voy a cantar cada contacto por su referencia, después su tipo, después hacia dónde va.

taller.role: TALLER: the hangar chief who straps the warheads on. The rack, the aircraft, resupply.

en.reference: Taller here. The birds are on the bench and the warheads are strapped on. Bring back what you can, and if you cannot, I have more in the shed.

es.reference: Acá Taller. Los aparatos están en el banco y las ojivas están puestas. Traigan lo que puedan, y si no pueden, tengo más en el galpón.

despacho.role: DESPACHO: the load dispatcher on a line from the grid. What the hits mean beyond the dam.

en.reference: Dispatch on the line. The west corridor is carrying the load, the east is on standby. I will tell you which towns go dark, and how long a reroute takes.

es.reference: Despacho en la línea. El corredor oeste lleva la carga, el este está en espera. Les voy a decir qué ciudades quedan a oscuras, y cuánto tarda un desvío.

carancho.role: CARANCHO: the lead of the other flight, on the river below the dam. The war beyond the pilots' sight.

en.reference: Carancho here, below the dam on the river. My flight is holding the bridge, birds are low but we are still in the air. Watch your backs up there.

es.reference: Acá Carancho, abajo de la represa, sobre el río. Mi vuelo sostiene el puente, quedan pocos aparatos pero seguimos en el aire. Cuiden sus espaldas allá arriba.

vega.role: VEGA, Major Tomas Vega: The Interior's operations commander. Command calls every pilot hears (docs/campaign/interior/BIBLE.md 5).

en.reference: Vega. Observation first. I do not need a theory, I need to know what you can actually see. Unknown means unknown, and it stays unknown until the picture says otherwise.

es.reference: Habla Vega. Primero se observa. No necesito una teoría, necesito saber lo que ustedes pueden ver de verdad. Desconocido quiere decir desconocido, hasta que la imagen diga otra cosa.

ibarra.role: IBARRA, Sofia Ibarra: The Interior's intelligence analyst. Finding, following, identifying, the archive; guide of ISR, TRACKER and RECON (BIBLE.md 5).

en.reference: Ibarra on the desk. That matches the pattern, it does not confirm the identity. History is useful until people stop behaving like history, so keep watching and tell me what changes.

es.reference: Ibarra en el escritorio. Eso coincide con el patrón, no confirma la identidad. La historia sirve hasta que la gente deja de comportarse como la historia, así que mantengan la observación.

ibarra-guide.role: IBARRA's guide lines (The Interior): the same voice, its reference and Kokoro voice Ibarra's own, read clean, with no radio crackle, key-up or squelch: the owner's rule is crackle only at scripted story moments, and a guide line is not one.

en.reference: Ibarra on the desk. That matches the pattern, it does not confirm the identity. History is useful until people stop behaving like history, so keep watching and tell me what changes.

es.reference: Ibarra en el escritorio. Eso coincide con el patrón, no confirma la identidad. La historia sirve hasta que la gente deja de comportarse como la historia, así que mantengan la observación.

rojas.role: ROJAS, Captain Adrian Rojas: The Interior's ground liaison. The units under the drones; guide of GROUND SUPPORT and STRIKE (BIBLE.md 5).

en.reference: Rojas, on the move. That is easy to say from fifteen kilometers away. I do not need perfect, I need useful, and if you see something moving toward my people, tell me.

es.reference: Acá Rojas, en movimiento. Eso es fácil de decir a quince kilómetros. No necesito algo perfecto, necesito algo útil, y si ven algo que se mueve hacia mi gente, avísenme.

ferrer.role: FERRER, Lucia Ferrer: The Interior's signals and systems officer. Telemetry, feeds, other aircraft; guide of RELAY and INTERCEPTOR (BIBLE.md 5).

en.reference: Ferrer on systems. Video is clean and telemetry is good. If anything else shows up in our airspace, you will hear it from me first, and I will not dress it up.

es.reference: Ferrer en sistemas. El video está limpio y la telemetría está bien. Si aparece cualquier otra cosa en nuestro espacio aéreo, lo van a escuchar primero de mí, sin adornos.

archive-a.role: ARCHIVE A: the first of the old radio voices of the Interior's opening film, recorded years before the campaign (BIBLE.md 5, one off voices). Generated, never sampled.

en.reference: Patrol two, on the net. We are holding at the tree line, the light is going. Ground is wet and the tracks are old. Waiting for orders.

es.reference: Patrulla dos, en la red. Estamos detenidos en la línea de árboles, se va la luz. El suelo está mojado y las huellas son viejas. Esperamos órdenes.

archive-b.role: ARCHIVE B: the second old radio voice of the opening film, the one asking (BIBLE.md 5, one off voices). Generated, never sampled.

en.reference: Base copies. Say again your position. How many, and which way are they headed. Report when you have something you can confirm.

es.reference: Base recibe. Repita su posición. Cuántos son, y hacia dónde van. Informe cuando tenga algo que pueda confirmar.

archive-c.role: ARCHIVE C: the third old radio voice of the opening film, the report read aloud (BIBLE.md 5, one off voices). Generated, never sampled.

en.reference: Report for the sector. Units searched the ground at first light and returned at dusk. Nothing found, nothing confirmed. The search continues tomorrow.

es.reference: Informe del sector. Las unidades revisaron el terreno al amanecer y volvieron al anochecer. Nada encontrado, nada confirmado. La búsqueda sigue mañana.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 1, title card. Two words over black, heavy and slow, like opening a file. Whisper writes the year as digits.
lines.en: Twenty thirty.
lines.es: Dos mil treinta.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 2, the Strikers cross the water. Tired certainty, a beat between the last three words.
lines.en: Wars aren't won with jets anymore. They're won with swarms. Cheap. Fast. Endless.
lines.es: Las guerras ya no se ganan con aviones de combate. Se ganan con enjambres. Baratos. Rápidos. Interminables.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 3, along the crest. Quiet, almost to himself; lands on 'this one'.
lines.en: Every country's lights hang on a few structures. Ours hang on this one.
lines.es: La luz de cada país cuelga de un puñado de estructuras. La nuestra cuelga de esta.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 4, the shed. A pause before 'is you', no pity in it.
lines.en: The interceptors ran out in the first week. What we have left... is you.
lines.es: Los interceptores se acabaron la primera semana. Lo que nos queda... son ustedes.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 5, props spin up. Briefing voice, clipped.
lines.en: Every aircraft in your hangar carries a warhead now. One flight. One kill. Make it count.
lines.es: Cada aparato de sus hangares lleva una ojiva. Un vuelo. Un derribo. Que cuente.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 6, static in the gorge. A warning from someone who has lost birds this way.
lines.en: Lose your signal, you lose your bird. Stay high. Stay in line of sight.
lines.es: Si pierden la señal, pierden el aparato. Manténganse altos. Manténganse en línea de vista.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Shot 7, the first wave on the horizon. Rising; the last words are an order.
lines.en: Contacts north, over the water. All pilots... get up there.
lines.es: Contactos al norte, sobre el agua. Todos los pilotos... ¡arriba!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission start, after the countdown.
lines.en: Pilots of both banks, this is Crest Control. Warheads armed. Good hunting.
lines.es: Pilotos de las dos márgenes, aquí Control Cresta. Ojivas armadas. Buena cacería.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Scout wave is born. Matter of fact.
lines.en: Scout up high, circling. Kill it and the next wave flies blind.
lines.es: Explorador en altura, dando vueltas. Derríbenlo y la próxima oleada vuela a ciegas.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Loiterer wave is born.
lines.en: Loiterers, high, circling. They'll dive on the intakes. Get above them.
lines.es: Merodeadores en altura, orbitando. Van a picar sobre las tomas. Pónganse encima.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Striker wave is born. The plan's own example call.
lines.en: Strikers, low, over the reservoir. Fast movers. Cut them off.
lines.es: Drones de ataque, bajos, sobre el embalse. Vienen rápido. Córtenles el paso.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Swarm FPV wave is born.
lines.en: Swarm coming up the gorge. FPVs, low and weaving. Go meet them.
lines.es: Enjambre subiendo por el cañón. Vienen bajos y zigzagueando. Salgan a recibirlos.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Hunter wave is born. Personal: these come for the pilots.
lines.en: Hunters inbound. They're coming for you, not the dam. Watch your backs.
lines.es: Cazadores en camino. Vienen por ustedes, no por la represa. Cuiden sus espaldas.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A sea drone wave is born.
lines.en: Sea drones on the reservoir, heading for the dam. Get down on the water.
lines.es: Drones navales en el embalse, rumbo a la represa. Bajen al agua.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Jammer is born.
lines.en: Jammer on the field. Your video's about to get ugly. Hunt it down.
lines.es: Hay un inhibidor activo. Se les va a ensuciar el video. Encuéntrenlo y elimínenlo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The mission's last wave is born.
lines.en: Last wave. Everything they've got. Hold the line.
lines.es: Última oleada. Vienen con todo. Aguanten.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Every attacker of a wave is dead and more waves remain.
lines.en: Wave down. Reset and climb. More coming.
lines.es: Oleada abatida. Reagrúpense y suban. Vienen más.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: An attacker reached an intake. No number: the HUD shows which one and the megawatts.
lines.en: Intake's hit! We're losing output!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en una toma! ¡Estamos perdiendo generación!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: An attacker reached a penstock. Whisper splits the word in two.

en: Penn stock hit! We just lost a unit!

lines.en: Penstock hit! We just lost a unit!
lines.es: ¡Le dieron a una tubería forzada! ¡Perdimos una unidad!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: An attacker reached a spillway gate.
lines.en: Spillway gate's hit! Keep them off the crest!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en una compuerta del vertedero! ¡Que no lleguen a la cresta!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: An attacker reached the right bank switchyard.
lines.en: Switchyard's hit! The right bank's going dark!
lines.es: ¡Impacto en la subestación! ¡La margen derecha se queda a oscuras!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Output is one target away from the floor.
lines.en: We're right on the edge. One more hit and the grid goes.
lines.es: Estamos al límite. Un impacto más y se cae la red.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The local pilot detonated on an attacker. Short, satisfied.
lines.en: Splash one.
lines.es: Uno menos. Bien hecho.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Alternate of kill-1, so repeats do not grate.
lines.en: Good kill.
lines.es: Buen derribo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: One detonation took more than one attacker.
lines.en: Multiple kills! That's how it's done!
lines.es: ¡Derribo múltiple! ¡Así se hace!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Every Scout of a wave is dead: later waves now fly with error.
lines.en: Scout's down. They're flying blind now.
lines.es: Explorador abatido. Ahora vuelan a ciegas.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A Jammer is dead and its jamming lifts.
lines.en: Jammer's down. Your video should clear.
lines.es: Inhibidor abatido. Se les debería limpiar el video.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A defender was lost to a crash, a Hunter or failsafe; a rack slot is gone.
lines.en: We lost a bird. Next one up.
lines.es: Perdimos un aparato. Que salga el siguiente.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The shared rack is nearly empty.
lines.en: Rack's running low. Make every flight count.
lines.es: Nos quedan pocos aparatos. Que cada vuelo cuente.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: One airframe left in the rack.
lines.en: Last airframe. Don't waste it.
lines.es: Último aparato. No lo desperdicien.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Local link quality fell under the snow threshold.
lines.en: Your signal's breaking up. Climb!
lines.es: Se les corta la señal. ¡Suban!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Local link lost.
lines.en: Lost your link! Your bird's on its own!
lines.es: ¡Perdieron el enlace! ¡El aparato está solo!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Local link restored before the airframe was lost.
lines.en: Link's back. You're flying.
lines.es: Enlace recuperado. Vuelven a tener el control.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A relay aircraft was lost or fell under relay height.
lines.en: Relay's down! Get another one up high!
lines.es: ¡Cayó el repetidor! ¡Suban otro, bien alto!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: A relay aircraft reached relay height.
lines.en: Relay's up. Anyone down in the gorge, you've got signal.
lines.es: Repetidor arriba. Los que estén en el cañón, ya tienen señal.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Last wave dead, output above the floor. Relief under the gravel.
lines.en: All contacts down. The dam holds. Good work, both banks. The lights stay on tonight.
lines.es: Todos los contactos abatidos. La represa resiste. Buen trabajo, las dos márgenes. Esta noche no se apaga la luz.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Output fell under the floor. Flat, beaten.
lines.en: We're below the floor. The grid's gone dark... All pilots, pull back.
lines.es: Estamos bajo el mínimo. La red se apagó... Todos los pilotos, repliéguense.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The rack is empty with attackers alive.
lines.en: No birds left. We can't hold it... All pilots, pull back.
lines.es: No quedan aparatos. No podemos sostenerla... Todos los pilotos, repliéguense.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 won, First Light (MISSIONS.md M1). Relief under control.
lines.en: Sun's up and the dam's still ours. Good flying, both banks.
lines.es: Salió el sol y la represa sigue siendo nuestra. Buen vuelo, las dos márgenes.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 lost, First Light. Tired, not angry.
lines.en: Too many got through. We go again.
lines.es: Pasaron demasiados. Vamos de nuevo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 won, The Spillway (MISSIONS.md M2).
lines.en: The spill held and the river did what we told it. Nice work on the water.
lines.es: El vertido aguantó y el río hizo lo que le dijimos. Buen trabajo sobre el agua.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 lost, The Spillway.
lines.en: Too many gates down. We can't steer the river like this. Pull back.
lines.es: Cayeron demasiadas compuertas. Así no manejamos el río. Repliéguense.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 3 briefing. The switchyard, and the trick.
lines.en: Mission three. They're after the switchyard. Kill it and both banks go dark.
lines.es: Misión tres. Van por la subestación. Si cae, las dos márgenes quedan a oscuras.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 3 briefing, second line. A warning, leaning in.
lines.en: Some of those Strikers are decoys. Get close before you spend a bird.
lines.es: Algunos de esos drones de ataque son señuelos. Acérquense antes de gastar un aparato.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 3 won.
lines.en: The switchyard held. The lights stayed on. Well done.
lines.es: La subestación resistió. La luz sigue encendida. Bien hecho.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 3 lost.
lines.en: The right bank is dark. We'll get it back. Regroup.
lines.es: La margen derecha está a oscuras. La vamos a recuperar. Reagrúpense.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 4 briefing, at night. Low and steady. Whisper writes the number as a digit.

en: Mission 4. Night raid on the intakes. You'll see less. So will they.
es: Misión 4. Ataque nocturno contra las tomas. Van a ver menos. Ellos también.

lines.en: Mission four. Night raid on the intakes. You'll see less. So will they.
lines.es: Misión cuatro. Ataque nocturno contra las tomas. Van a ver menos. Ellos también.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 4 briefing, second line.
lines.en: Trust your markers, fly low, and hold the dam until sunrise.
lines.es: Confíen en los marcadores, vuelen bajo y defiendan la represa hasta el amanecer.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 4 won, at dawn.
lines.en: Sunrise, and the dam still stands. That's the whole first act. Good work.
lines.es: Amanece, y la represa sigue en pie. Ese fue el primer acto completo. Buen trabajo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 4 lost.
lines.en: They got through in the dark. Pull back. We go again tomorrow night.
lines.es: Pasaron en la oscuridad. Repliéguense. Volvemos mañana a la noche.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group from the north sector is born. Said before the kind call, as one radio item.
lines.en: From the north, over open water.
lines.es: Desde el norte, sobre agua abierta.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group from the west arm (NW).
lines.en: Out of the west arm.
lines.es: Desde el brazo oeste.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group off the east shore (NE).
lines.en: Off the east shore.
lines.es: Desde la costa este.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group high over the islands.
lines.en: High, over the islands.
lines.es: En altura, sobre las islas.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group on the reservoir's surface.
lines.en: On the water, coming for the face.
lines.es: Sobre el agua, rumbo a la cara.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group up the gorge from the south.
lines.en: Up the gorge, under the rims.
lines.es: Subiendo por el cañón, bajo los bordes.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group on the river below the dam.
lines.en: On the river, below the dam.
lines.es: Sobre el río, aguas abajo.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a group along the power corridors.
lines.en: Along the lines, low.
lines.es: Siguiendo las líneas, bajo.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a beat between stages opens; the rack is full again.
lines.en: Birds are on the bench. Come get them.
lines.es: Los aparatos están en el banco. Vengan a buscarlos.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: the alternate of beat-rack.
lines.en: Warheads on. Same as before.
lines.es: Ojivas puestas. Igual que antes.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: MISSIONS.md 1.8: a stage is lost.
lines.en: They got through. Regroup on the crest.
lines.es: Pasaron. Reagrúpense en la cresta.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 1 (INTROS.md 5.1): the title card. Two words over the water at dawn, heavy and slow. Whisper writes the year as digits.
lines.en: Twenty thirty.
lines.es: Dos mil treinta.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 2: one Striker grows out of the haze. Tired certainty.
lines.en: Wars aren't won with jets anymore.
lines.es: Las guerras ya no se ganan con aviones de combate.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 4: the ten coming on. A beat between the last three words. Not 'won': Whisper hears it as 'one' every take, and a listener could too, so the line is rephrased.
lines.en: They're fought with swarms. Cheap. Fast. Endless.
lines.es: Se ganan con enjambres. Baratos. Rápidos. Interminables.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 5: up the face and over the crest. Quiet, lands on 'this one'.
lines.en: Every country's lights hang on a few structures. Ours hang on this one.
lines.es: La luz de cada país cuelga de un puñado de estructuras. La nuestra cuelga de esta.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 6: the line of aircraft. A pause before 'is you', no pity in it.
lines.en: The interceptors ran out in the first week. What we have left... is you.
lines.es: Los interceptores se acabaron la primera semana. Lo que nos queda... son ustedes.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: First Light film, shots 7a to 7c: the spin up. TALLER, gruff, clipped.
lines.en: Every bird in the hangar carries a warhead now. One flight. One kill. Make it count.
lines.es: Cada aparato del hangar lleva una ojiva. Un vuelo. Un derribo. Que cuente.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: First Light film, shot 8: the first wave on the horizon. Rising; the last words an order.
lines.en: Contacts north, over the water. All pilots... get up there.
lines.es: Contactos al norte, sobre el agua. Todos los pilotos... ¡arriba!

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1, the countdown's first line (MISSIONS.md M1 radio).
lines.en: Pilots of both banks, this is Crest. Something's been circling since before light.
lines.es: Pilotos de las dos márgenes, aquí Cresta. Algo da vueltas desde antes del amanecer.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: Mission 1, the countdown's second line: the rack's rule.
lines.en: Every bird has a warhead. One flight, one kill. Every kill earns another.
lines.es: Cada aparato lleva su ojiva. Un vuelo, un derribo. Cada derribo gana otro.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 1, three seconds after the scout is born.
lines.en: Something high over the water. Slow. Circling.
lines.es: Algo en altura sobre el agua. Lento. Dando vueltas.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 1, after s1-eyes.
lines.en: That's their eyes. Take it down and whatever comes next flies blind.
lines.es: Esos son sus ojos. Derríbenlo y lo que venga después vuela a ciegas.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 1, the scout killed.
lines.en: Scout's down. They just lost their eyes.
lines.es: Explorador abatido. Acaban de perder los ojos.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 1, the scout finished its orbit and left.
lines.en: It's gone home. They know where we are now.
lines.es: Se fue. Ahora saben dónde estamos.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 2, four seconds after the first group is born.
lines.en: A single fast mover. They're timing us. Meet it early.
lines.es: Uno solo, rápido. Nos están midiendo. Salgan temprano a su encuentro.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 2, the second group born.
lines.en: Another one, different side. Same speed.
lines.es: Otro, por otro lado. Misma velocidad.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 2 cleared.
lines.en: That was a test. The next one won't be.
lines.es: Eso fue una prueba. Lo próximo no.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 3, two seconds after the Loiterers are born.
lines.en: High and low together. Planes up top. Quads stay on the deck.
lines.es: Arriba y abajo a la vez. Aviones arriba. Los cuadricópteros, abajo.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 3, the stage's first kill.
lines.en: That's the way. Bring the next bird back in one piece, if you can.
lines.es: Así se hace. El próximo aparato tráiganlo entero, si se puede.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 3 cleared.
lines.en: Scope's clean. For now.
lines.es: Pantalla limpia. Por ahora.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist A, the swarm in the gorge born.
lines.en: Wait. Movement in the gorge. Behind you.
lines.es: Esperen. Movimiento en el cañón. Detrás de ustedes.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist A, after ta-turn.
lines.en: The north run is the decoy. The swarm wants the penstocks. Somebody turn around.
lines.es: Lo del norte es la distracción. El enjambre quiere las tuberías. Alguien dé la vuelta.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist B, the boats cross the east shore's midpoint.
lines.en: Wakes on the east shore. Small, fast, low in the water.
lines.es: Estelas en la costa este. Chicas, rápidas, bajas en el agua.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist B, after tb-turn.
lines.en: Boats. They'll hug the shore all the way to the face. Get down on the water.
lines.es: Lanchas. Van a ir pegadas a la costa hasta la cara. Bajen al agua.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist C, the Hunters born.
lines.en: Those aren't going for the dam. They're turning toward our birds.
lines.es: Esos no van por la represa. Están girando hacia nuestros aparatos.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 twist C, after tc-turn.
lines.en: Hunters. Pair up. One baits, one kills.
lines.es: Cazadores. Vuelen de a dos. Uno hace de cebo, el otro derriba.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 5, its first birth.
lines.en: Contacts everywhere. North, high, the gorge. This is it.
lines.es: Contactos por todos lados. Norte, altura, el cañón. Es ahora.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The Spillway film, shot 2 (INTROS.md 5.2): the crane up a gate from the waterline. Plain, tired: weather, not drama.
lines.en: It rained upstream all night. The reservoir's at the top of the gates.
lines.es: Llovió toda la noche aguas arriba. El embalse está al tope de las compuertas.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: The Spillway film, shot 3: the scope, contacts appearing in the west arm.
lines.en: They've been gathering in the west arm since noon. They know we have to spill.
lines.es: Se están juntando en el brazo oeste desde el mediodía. Saben que tenemos que verter.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The Spillway film, shot 4: riding the channel as a Striker would, the gates growing.
lines.en: If they take the working gates, we lose control of the river.
lines.es: Si nos sacan las compuertas que funcionan, perdemos el control del río.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: The Spillway film, shot 6: the half orbit, the working gates outlined. An order.
lines.en: Opening them now. Keep them alive.
lines.es: Abriendo ahora. Manténganlas vivas.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2, the countdown's first line (MISSIONS.md M2 radio).
lines.en: Reservoir's high and still rising. We spill this afternoon, whatever they think about it.
lines.es: El embalse está alto y sigue subiendo. Esta tarde vertemos, piensen lo que piensen ellos.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2, the countdown's second line.
lines.en: They've been watching the right bank all morning. They know which gates move.
lines.es: Estuvieron mirando la margen derecha toda la mañana. Saben qué compuertas se mueven.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 1, three seconds after the Scout is born. Flat, observing. The Spanish says vueltas lentas: Whisper heard despacio as de espacio in every one of its takes, which a listener could too.
lines.en: Something high, circling slow. It's watching the right bank.
lines.es: Algo en altura, dando vueltas lentas. Está mirando la margen derecha.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 1, two seconds after the Loiterers are born.
lines.en: Loiterers. They'll circle, then drop on the gates. Get above them.
lines.es: Merodeadores. Van a orbitar y después caer sobre las compuertas. Pónganse encima.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 1 cleared. Dry, a little relieved.
lines.en: Good. The gates don't know how close that was.
lines.es: Bien. Las compuertas no saben lo cerca que estuvo.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 2, the boats born.
lines.en: Wakes in the approach channel. They're using the current.
lines.es: Estelas en el canal de aproximación. Están usando la corriente.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 2, the Strikers born.
lines.en: And fast movers right behind them, low up the channel.
lines.es: Y atrás vienen rápidos, bajos por el canal.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 2 cleared: the channel empty again.
lines.en: Channel's clean. Nothing on the water.
lines.es: El canal está limpio. Nada sobre el agua.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 3 opens: the working gates start to open. The Spanish is not MISSIONS.md's: Whisper heard "Abriendo las compuertas" as "Abriéndolas con puertas" and "Manténganlas" as "Manténgalas" in every one of its takes, which a listener could too.
lines.en: Opening the working gates now. Keep them alive until the spill is running.
lines.es: Abrimos las compuertas en servicio. No las dejen caer hasta que corra el vertido.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 3, the hold at half.
lines.en: Water's over the sills. Halfway.
lines.es: El agua pasa por los umbrales. Vamos por la mitad.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 3, the hold done.
lines.en: Spill's running. The river is ours to steer.
lines.es: El vertido corre. El río lo manejamos nosotros.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 3, a working gate hit during the hold.
lines.en: We lost a working gate. Spill on the rest. Protect what's left.
lines.es: Perdimos una compuerta en servicio. Vertemos con las demás. Protejan lo que queda.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist A: Loiterers out of the spray.
lines.en: Something in the spray. I can't hold it on the scope.
lines.es: Hay algo en la bruma. No lo puedo mantener en pantalla.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist A, after ta-turn: Loiterers diving out of the spill's spray, where the markers fail.
lines.en: The spray's hiding them. Stay close to the gates and trust your eyes.
lines.es: La bruma los esconde. Quédense cerca de las compuertas y confíen en sus ojos.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist B: boats down the west arm.
lines.en: More wakes, out of the west arm. Everyone's too high.
lines.es: Más estelas, desde el brazo oeste. Están todos muy altos.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist B, after tb-turn: boats down the west arm while the squad is high.
lines.en: Boats, hugging the west shore. Somebody get down on the water, now.
lines.es: Lanchas, pegadas a la costa oeste. Que alguien baje al agua, ya.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist C: Hunters over the chute.
lines.en: Hunters over the chute. Anyone low on the channel, you've got company.
lines.es: Cazadores sobre el canal de descarga. Los que estén bajos en el canal, tienen compañía.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: Mission 2 twist C, after tc-turn: Hunters over the chute. Rough, close, a little breath.
lines.en: Go down there in pairs. I can't build birds that fast.
lines.es: Bajen de a dos. No armo aparatos tan rápido.

lines.speaker: mirador
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 4, its first birth.
lines.en: Everything's turning for the working gates.
lines.es: Todo está girando hacia las compuertas en servicio.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 4, after s4-all: everything converging on the working gates.
lines.en: Stay on the working gates. Let the others go if you have to.
lines.es: Quédense sobre las compuertas en servicio. Si hace falta, dejen las otras.

lines.speaker: taller
lines.notes: Mission 2 stage 4, the first kill. Dry, approving.
lines.en: That's it. Keep that water running.
lines.es: Eso es. Que el agua siga corriendo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 stage 5, after s5-all.
lines.en: Everybody up. Take the closest and don't chase.
lines.es: Todos arriba. Tomen el más cercano y no lo persigan.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, stage 1 open: how a kill is made. Plain, a briefing, not a speech.
lines.en: Your bird is the weapon. Fly at a marked contact. In range, the warhead goes off by itself.
lines.es: Su aparato es el arma. Vuelen hacia un contacto marcado. Dentro del alcance, la ojiva estalla sola.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, stage 1: the objective, after s1-why.
lines.en: Your job now is the scout. It circles high over the reservoir, north of the dam. Climb and kill it.
lines.es: Su tarea ahora es el explorador. Da vueltas en altura sobre el embalse, al norte de la represa. Suban y derríbenlo.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, stage 2 open: the objective.
lines.en: Protect the intakes on the upstream face. Strikers come in low over the water. Fly north and meet them early.
lines.es: Protejan las tomas de la cara aguas arriba. Los atacantes vienen bajo, sobre el agua. Vuelen al norte y salgan a su encuentro temprano.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, stage 3 open: the objective.
lines.en: Protect the intakes and the gates. Some come high, some come low. Take the one closest to the dam first.
lines.es: Protejan las tomas y las compuertas. Unos llegan por arriba, otros por abajo. Primero el más cercano a la represa.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, twist A, after ta-why: where to fly.
lines.en: Cross the crest and drop down the far side. Stop the swarm before the penstocks.
lines.es: Crucen la cresta y bajen del otro lado. Paren el enjambre antes de las tuberías.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, twist B, after tb-why: where to fly.
lines.en: The boats run along the east shore. Fly low over the water and hit them before the face.
lines.es: Las lanchas van por la costa este. Vuelen bajo sobre el agua y péguenles antes de la cara.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, twist C, after tc-why: what to do.
lines.en: The Hunters chase your bird. Don't fly straight. Turn into them and take them first.
lines.es: Los cazadores persiguen su aparato. No vuelen recto. Giren hacia ellos y derríbenlos primero.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: Mission 1 guide, stage 5, after s5-order: the objective.
lines.en: Protect the plant. Three groups at once. The closest to the dam first, then the next.
lines.es: Protejan la planta. Tres grupos a la vez. Primero el más cercano a la represa, después el siguiente.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge (src/share/war/nudge.js), before a clock bearing and a distance: the attacker nearest the targets.
lines.en: Closest to the dam.
lines.es: El más cercano a la represa.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: One o'clock.
lines.es: A la una.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Two o'clock.
lines.es: A las dos.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Three o'clock.
lines.es: A las tres.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Four o'clock.
lines.es: A las cuatro.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Five o'clock.
lines.es: A las cinco.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Six o'clock.
lines.es: A las seis.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Seven o'clock.
lines.es: A las siete.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Eight o'clock.
lines.es: A las ocho.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Nine o'clock.
lines.es: A las nueve.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Ten o'clock.
lines.es: A las diez.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Eleven o'clock.
lines.es: A las once.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: the bearing off the nose as a clock hour, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.
lines.en: Twelve o'clock.
lines.es: A las doce.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: About five hundred metres.
lines.es: A unos quinientos metros.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: About one kilometre away.
lines.es: A cerca de un kilómetro.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: About two kilometres.
lines.es: A unos dos kilómetros.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: About three kilometres.
lines.es: A unos tres kilómetros.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: About five kilometres.
lines.es: A unos cinco kilómetros.

lines.speaker: crest
lines.notes: War guide nudge: how far, after the clock bearing. A measured distance from the game, not a sourced figure.
lines.en: More than six kilometres.
lines.es: A más de seis kilómetros.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, every mission: boundary(warning), to the pilot crossing. Even, no alarm.
lines.en: Pilot, you're at the edge of the sector. Turn back.
lines.es: Piloto, están en el borde del sector. Regresen.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, every mission: boundary(final), to the pilot crossing. Flat and final.
lines.en: Last warning. Turn back now.
lines.es: Última advertencia. Regresen ya.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior, every mission: an aircraft lost while another flies. Dry, practical.
lines.en: We lost that aircraft. Bring up another.
lines.es: Perdimos ese aparato. Levanten otro.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, every mission: a fail for lost capability. Quiet, no blame.
lines.en: We've lost the picture. We go again.
lines.es: Perdimos la imagen. Volvemos a empezar.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior, any mission photographing people: they are looking up at a low aircraft. Low voice, quick.
lines.en: You're too low. Climb.
lines.es: Están muy bajos. Suban.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior, any mission photographing people: they saw the aircraft and scatter. Flat, no panic.
lines.en: They've seen you.
lines.es: Los vieron.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, after int-spot-seen: the advice when the aircraft was simply too low. Teaching, no blame.
lines.en: You came in too low. Stay high and use the zoom.
lines.es: Entraron muy bajo. Manténganse alto y usen el zoom.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, after int-spot-seen: the advice when the aircraft passed right over them. Teaching, no blame.
lines.en: You flew straight over them. Offset and orbit wide.
lines.es: Pasaron justo encima de ellos. Desvíense y orbiten amplio.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior, after int-spot-seen: the advice when the aircraft was at full power close by. Teaching, no blame.
lines.en: Full power that close, they heard you. Throttle back on the approach.
lines.es: A toda potencia tan cerca, los escucharon. Bajen el acelerador al acercarse.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior, every mission: to a pilot who took a free role. A handing over.
lines.en: Feed's yours.
lines.es: La señal es de ustedes.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 1, survey altitude reached. Routine.
lines.en: Survey One telemetry clean.
lines.es: Telemetría de Relevamiento Uno, limpia.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s1-clean. Two words of order.
lines.en: Proceed Sector Alpha.
lines.es: Procedan al sector Alfa.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the first Alpha capture. Teaching, not praising.
lines.en: Good. Hold the frame for a second.
lines.es: Bien. Sostengan el cuadro un segundo.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 Alpha complete.
lines.en: Alpha complete. Continue Bravo.
lines.es: Alfa completo. Continúen con Bravo.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 the burned field captured. Offhand.
lines.en: That burned last week.
lines.es: Eso se quemó la semana pasada.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after burned-1. A real question.
lines.en: Accidental?
lines.es: ¿Accidental?

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after burned-2. A shrug.
lines.en: Probably.
lines.es: Probablemente.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after burned-3. Dry, precise.
lines.en: Probably isn't useful.
lines.es: Probablemente no es útil.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after burned-4. Warm humour with an edge, to the squad.
lines.en: You're going to love this place.
lines.es: Les va a encantar este lugar.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 a camera held on the teacher's house. Matter of fact.
lines.en: House near the water belongs to the local schoolteacher.
lines.es: La casa junto al agua es de la maestra de la colonia.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after teacher-1.
lines.en: Relevant?
lines.es: ¿Es relevante?

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after teacher-2. Flat.
lines.en: No.
lines.es: No.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after teacher-3 and a beat. The point made.
lines.en: That's my point.
lines.es: A eso voy.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 Bravo complete.
lines.en: Proceed Charlie.
lines.es: Procedan a Charlie.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the discovery window ran out. Sudden, low.
lines.en: Survey One, hold.
lines.es: Relevamiento Uno, en espera.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s3-hold. A bearing, spelled; Whisper writes the hour as digits.

en: Tree line. 11 o'clock from your nose.
Treeline. Eleven o'clock from your nose.
es: Línea de árboles. A las 11 de la nariz.

lines.en: Tree line. Eleven o'clock from your nose.
lines.es: Línea de árboles. A las once de la nariz.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 the pair discovered. One word, waiting.
lines.en: Classification?
lines.es: ¿Clasificación?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s3-class. Certain.
lines.en: None.
lines.es: Ninguna.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s3-none. An observation, half a theory.
lines.en: They're avoiding the road.
lines.es: Están evitando el camino.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s3-road. A correction, not a sneer.
lines.en: That isn't a classification.
lines.es: Eso no es una clasificación.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s3-notclass. The order, quiet.
lines.en: Follow.
lines.es: Síganlos.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 the pair first lost under canopy. Wry.
lines.en: Welcome to the Interior.
lines.es: Bienvenidos al Interior.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the pair lost twenty seconds.
lines.en: I've lost them.
lines.es: Los perdí.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-lost. A question to the squad.
lines.en: Pilot?
lines.es: ¿Piloto?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the pair reacquired. Quick.
lines.en: There.
lines.es: Ahí están.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-there and a beat.
lines.en: Good eye.
lines.es: Buen ojo.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 the hard threshold, alternate on the cañada.
lines.en: Check the drainage line east of last contact.
lines.es: Revisen la cañada al este del último contacto.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 the hard threshold, alternate on a path crossing.
lines.en: Check the path crossing north of last contact.
lines.es: Revisen el cruce de senderos al norte del último contacto.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 the long objects at the narrow opening. Sure of himself.
lines.en: Armed.
lines.es: Armados.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-armed. Even.
lines.en: Possible.
lines.es: Es posible.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-possible. Exasperated.
lines.en: Come on.
lines.es: Por favor.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-comeon. Precise, what is known.
lines.en: One object consistent with a rifle. One unclear.
lines.es: Un objeto compatible con un fusil. Otro sin determinar.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s4-rifle. Settles it.
lines.en: Then that's what we know.
lines.es: Entonces eso es lo que sabemos.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 5 opens. A rule.
lines.en: No low pass.
lines.es: Nada de pasadas bajas.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-nolow. Firm: every calm take ran on into a babble after the line.
lines.en: Record everything.
lines.es: Graben todo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the symbol captured. Careful, to command.
lines.en: Command, confirm you are receiving.
lines.es: Comando, confirme que está recibiendo.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-receiving.
lines.en: We are.
lines.es: Recibimos.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-weare; the archive searching. Half to herself.
lines.en: I'm checking something.
lines.es: Estoy verificando algo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after a pause. Quiet; it matters.
lines.en: That mark is historical.
lines.es: Esa marca es histórica.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-historical. Disbelief.
lines.en: The Column?
lines.es: ¿La Columna?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-column.
lines.en: That symbol hasn't appeared in years.
lines.es: Ese símbolo no aparece hace años.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-years. To Ibarra.
lines.en: Doesn't answer his question.
lines.es: Eso no responde su pregunta.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-answer.
lines.en: No.
lines.es: No.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-no and a beat. Almost a whisper.
lines.en: But somebody remembers it.
lines.es: Pero alguien lo recuerda.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 the dispersal starts.
lines.en: They're moving.
lines.es: Se están moviendo.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-moving. To the squad.
lines.en: Pilot, remain high.
lines.es: Piloto, mantengan la altura.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-high. Pushing.
lines.en: We can get people moving toward them.
lines.es: Podemos mover gente hacia ellos.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-people. Not raised.
lines.en: No.
lines.es: No.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-noway. Cut off.
lines.en: Major.
lines.es: Mayor.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-major. Whisper writes the number as a digit.
lines.en: We found them five minutes ago.
lines.es: Los encontramos hace cinco minutos.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 after s5-fivemin and a beat. The lesson, never dramatic.
lines.en: That does not mean we understand what we found.
lines.es: Eso no quiere decir que entendamos lo que encontramos.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the camp alerted before the required intel.
lines.en: They heard you. Climb.
lines.es: Los escucharon. Suban.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 a TRACKER dealt; TRACKER only.
lines.en: Survey Two, take the far side. I'll call what I need.

lines.speaker: ibarra

lines.en: Get ahead of them. Watch the next gap.
lines.es: Adelántense. Vigilen el próximo claro.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 5, a TRACKER orbit sector; TRACKER only.
lines.en: Hold that side of the clearing. Different angle, same distance.
lines.es: Mantengan ese lado del claro. Otro ángulo, la misma distancia.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 the dispersal, a TRACKER direction; TRACKER only.
lines.en: Take the ones going your way. Don't go low.
lines.es: Tomen a los que van para su lado. No bajen.

lines.en: We lost the picture today. We go again tomorrow.
lines.es: Hoy perdimos la imagen. Mañana volvemos a intentarlo.

lines.en: We have movement near the tree line.
lines.es: Tenemos movimiento cerca de la línea de árboles.

lines.en: How many?
lines.es: ¿Cuántos?

lines.speaker: archive-a
lines.notes: Interior opening film, after intp-2.
lines.en: Can't tell.
lines.es: No se distingue.

lines.speaker: archive-c
lines.notes: Interior opening film, shot 2, the old photographs. A report read aloud.
lines.en: Units searched the sector. Negative contact.
lines.es: Las unidades revisaron el sector. Sin contacto.

lines.speaker: archive-a
lines.notes: Interior opening film, shot 3.
lines.en: Tracks disappeared near the river.
lines.es: Las huellas desaparecieron cerca del río.

lines.speaker: archive-b
lines.notes: Interior opening film, after intp-5.
lines.en: No confirmation.
lines.es: Sin confirmación.

lines.en: No confirmation.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior opening film, shot 6, the camera ball switching on. Reflective.
lines.en: For years, everyone asked the same question.
lines.es: Durante años, todos hicieron la misma pregunta.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior opening film, shot 7, the forest. Quiet.
lines.en: Where are they?
lines.es: ¿Dónde están?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior opening film, shot 8, the title. The question turned.
lines.en: Maybe that was the wrong question.
lines.es: Tal vez esa era la pregunta equivocada.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 1, the monitors. To the squad, not a challenge.
lines.en: You weren't sent here to hunt anybody.
lines.es: A ustedes no los mandaron aquí a cazar a nadie.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 2, the sectors.
lines.en: Officially, we're updating infrastructure imagery.
lines.es: Oficialmente, estamos actualizando imágenes de infraestructura.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, after int1-2. Knowing.
lines.en: And unofficially?
lines.es: ¿Y extraoficialmente?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 3, the stills.
lines.en: Unofficially, people have been reporting strange activity for months.
lines.es: Extraoficialmente, la gente viene reportando actividad extraña desde hace meses.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, after int1-4 and a pause.
lines.en: Nothing significant individually.
lines.es: Nada significativo por separado.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 4. Dry.
lines.en: Which usually means everyone ignores it.
lines.es: Lo que normalmente significa que todos lo ignoran.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, after int1-6.
lines.en: Until the insignificant things start forming a pattern.
lines.es: Hasta que las cosas insignificantes empiezan a formar un patrón.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 5, each thing marked on the map as it is said. Even beats.
lines.en: Roads. Bridges. Towers. Construction. Vehicles.
lines.es: Caminos. Puentes. Torres. Obras. Vehículos.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, shot 6, said to the player's seat.
lines.en: If you see something unusual, mark it.
lines.es: Si ven algo inusual, márquenlo.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 intro film, after int1-9 and the beat.
lines.en: Do not invent a story around it.
lines.es: No inventen una historia alrededor.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, shot 3, the match.
lines.en: So they're back.
lines.es: Así que volvieron.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, after int1-11. A real maybe.
lines.en: Maybe.
lines.es: Tal vez.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, after int1-12. To Ibarra.
lines.en: You just said that's their symbol.
lines.es: Usted acaba de decir que es su símbolo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, shot 4. Quiet.
lines.en: Symbols don't need permission to survive the people who created them.
lines.es: Los símbolos no necesitan permiso para sobrevivir a quienes los crearon.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, shot 5, the map zooming out.
lines.en: Tomorrow we stop looking at the camp.
lines.es: Mañana dejamos de mirar el campamento.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M1 outro film, shot 6, the marks around the dot.
lines.en: Tomorrow we look at everything around it.
lines.es: Mañana miramos todo lo que lo rodea.

lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 3 brief: fly to the corridor marker and watch.

en: Charlie. Fly to the marker and watch the treeline for movement.

lines.en: Charlie. Fly to the marker and watch the tree line for movement.
lines.es: Charlie. Vuelen hasta la marca y vigilen la línea de árboles.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 4 brief, the ISR: keep the pair in frame.

lines.es: Manténganlos en cuadro desde lo alto. Si los pierden, busquen en el círculo.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 4 brief, a TRACKER: a picket ahead of the pair.

en: Survey 2, work ahead of them. Watch the next gap from high up.
es: Relevamiento 2, adelántense. Vigilen el próximo claro desde lo alto.

lines.en: Survey Two, work ahead of them. Watch the next gap from high up.
lines.es: Relevamiento Dos, adelántense. Vigilen el próximo claro desde lo alto.

en: Document the camp from stand-off. Shelters, motorcycles, antenna, people, and the way in.
Document the camp from stand off. Shelters, motorcycles, antenna, people, and the way in.

lines.en: Document the camp from standoff. Shelters, motorcycles, antenna, people, and the way in.
lines.es: Documenten el campamento a distancia. Refugios, motos, antena, personas y el acceso.

lines.notes: Interior M1 stage 5 brief once the camp is documented: home.

lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 1, the diagram captured. Puzzled, then sure.
lines.en: That's not a map of the camp.
lines.es: Eso no es un mapa del campamento.

lines.notes: After s1-notmap. Two words, seeing it.
lines.en: Road network.
lines.es: Red de caminos.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s1-road. Naming it.
lines.en: Observation points.
lines.es: Puntos de observación.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: ISR only, after s1-points: hand back to the high aircraft.
lines.en: Back up high. Three places someone could sit and watch the road.
lines.es: Vuelvan arriba. Hay tres lugares desde donde alguien podría sentarse a mirar el camino.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: The required watcher seen. Half a joke.
lines.en: That your guy?
lines.es: ¿Ese es su hombre?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s1-guy. Dry, exact.
lines.en: He's a man standing next to a motorcycle.
lines.es: Es un hombre parado al lado de una moto.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After s1-man. Dry back.
lines.en: Thank you, Sofía.
lines.es: Gracias, Sofía.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s1-thanks. Flat.
lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.es: De nada.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: An optional watcher seen; ISR and TRACKER.
lines.en: Another one. Same habits. Mark it.
lines.es: Otro más. Las mismas costumbres. Márquenlo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: The watcher leaves as the convoy passes. Quiet, alert.
lines.en: Now he's interesting.
lines.es: Ahora sí es interesante.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: The handoff ends; two contacts split.
lines.en: Which one?
lines.es: ¿Cuál de los dos?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s2-which.
lines.en: Second contact.
lines.es: El segundo contacto.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After s2-second.
lines.en: Why?
lines.es: ¿Por qué?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s2-why. Thinking aloud.
lines.en: Because the first man's job may only have been to see.
lines.es: Porque quizás el trabajo del primero era solamente mirar.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Contact A followed; a courier leaves his post.
lines.en: Someone's leaving his post. Follow that one.
lines.es: Alguien deja su puesto. Sigan a ese.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: The property inspected. Realising.
lines.en: This is their warning system.
lines.es: Este es su sistema de alerta.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After s3-warning. Unimpressed.
lines.en: This?
lines.es: ¿Esto?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s3-this. Flat.
lines.en: This.
lines.es: Esto.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After s3-this2. Disbelief.
lines.en: A radio and a guy on a motorcycle?
lines.es: ¿Una radio y un tipo en moto?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s3-radio. Dry.
lines.en: You were expecting satellites?
lines.es: ¿Esperaba satélites?

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: The returner appears near the property. One word.
lines.en: Movement.
lines.es: Movimiento.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: RECON only, after s3-movement. Low voice.
lines.en: Stay where he can't see you. Let him come.
lines.es: Quédense donde no los vea. Déjenlo venir.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: The property's alertness high: the returner saw the quad.
lines.en: He saw you. He's running. Stay on him.
lines.es: Los vio. Se escapa. No lo pierdan.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Claro Nuevo discovered.
lines.en: That's a newer radio.
lines.es: Esa radio es más nueva.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s4-radio.
lines.en: Everything in this camp is newer.
lines.es: Todo acá es más nuevo.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After s4-newer.
lines.en: Replacement camp?
lines.es: ¿Un campamento de reemplazo?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s4-replacement. Heavier.
lines.en: Replacement people.
lines.es: Gente de reemplazo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: The older contact enters Claro Nuevo.
lines.en: Hold.
lines.es: Esperen.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: The older contact leaves.
lines.en: Same organization?
lines.es: ¿La misma organización?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s4-same.
lines.en: Same mythology.
lines.es: La misma mitología.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: After s4-myth. Clipped.
lines.en: Not what I asked.
lines.es: No es lo que pregunté.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s4-asked. Honest.
lines.en: It's the only answer I have.
lines.es: Es la única respuesta que tengo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: OBSERVE BOTH GROUPS opens.
lines.en: Two cells.
lines.es: Dos células.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: After s4-cells.
lines.en: Or two organizations.
lines.es: O dos organizaciones.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After s4-orgs. The mission's last line.

en: Same roots. Same symbols. Different people.

lines.en: Same routes. Same symbols. Different people.
lines.es: Las mismas rutas. Los mismos símbolos. Otra gente.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: TRACKER only, the zones open.
lines.en: Take that zone. Look for someone who isn't working.
lines.es: Tomen esa zona. Busquen a alguien que no esté trabajando.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: TRACKER only, the handoff split.
lines.en: You take the other one. Both of them matter.
lines.es: Ustedes tomen al otro. Los dos importan.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 1 brief: the empty camp, close with the quad.
lines.en: Claro Viejo is empty. Take the quad in close: the fire, the cable, the marks, the tracks and the board.
lines.es: Claro Viejo está vacío. Entren cerca con el cuadricóptero: la fogata, el cable, las marcas, las huellas y el tablero.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 1 brief: the three search areas.
lines.en: Three search areas. Look for a man who is watching the road.
lines.es: Tres áreas de búsqueda. Busquen a un hombre que esté mirando el camino.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 2 brief: follow the watcher.
lines.en: Stay on the motorcycle from high up. Don't crowd him.
lines.es: Sigan la moto desde lo alto. No se le acerquen.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 2 brief: the choice.
lines.en: Two contacts. Box the one you follow.
lines.es: Dos contactos. Encuadren al que van a seguir.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 3 brief: inside the house with the quad.
lines.en: The house. Take the quad inside: the batteries, the radio, the notes.
lines.es: La casa. Entren con el cuadricóptero: las baterías, la radio, las notas.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 3 brief once he comes: watch from cover.
lines.en: Watch him from cover. Away from the gate, and keep him in frame.
lines.es: Obsérvenlo desde cubierto. Lejos del portón, y manténganlo en cuadro.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 4 brief: the second camp from standoff.
lines.en: Document the second camp from high up. The people, the vehicles, the radio, the whole camp.
lines.es: Documenten el segundo campamento desde lo alto. La gente, los vehículos, la radio, el campamento entero.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M2 stage 4 brief: the meeting.
lines.en: Someone's coming in. Keep the frame on him until he's gone.
lines.es: Alguien está llegando. Manténganlo en cuadro hasta que se vaya.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M2 intro, shot 1, walking into the empty camp. Flat.
lines.en: Gone.
lines.es: Se fueron.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Shot 2, the rope swinging.
lines.en: How long?
lines.es: ¿Hace cuánto?

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After 2.
lines.en: Long enough.
lines.es: Lo suficiente.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Shot 3, the two stills side by side.
lines.en: They left before the first ground vehicle crossed into the sector.
lines.es: Se fueron antes de que el primer vehículo terrestre entrara al sector.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Shot 4.
lines.en: Radio interception?
lines.es: ¿Interceptaron la radio?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 5.
lines.en: Maybe.
lines.es: Puede ser.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After 6.
lines.en: Informant?
lines.es: ¿Un informante?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 7. The same word, more tired.
lines.en: Maybe.
lines.es: Puede ser.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Shot 5, the map widening.
lines.en: We're asking the wrong question.
lines.es: Estamos haciendo la pregunta equivocada.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: After 9.
lines.en: Don't ask how they escaped.
lines.es: No pregunten cómo escaparon.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Shot 6, sight lines from the roads.
lines.en: Ask what they saw.
lines.es: Pregunten qué vieron.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 11, when the player captured the symbol in Mission 1. A small credit, dry.
lines.en: You caught the symbol before I did.
lines.es: Ustedes vieron el símbolo antes que yo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 11, when the symbol was not captured in Mission 1.
lines.en: We only got the symbol from a partial angle.
lines.es: Solo tenemos el símbolo desde un ángulo parcial.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Shot 7, the recon quad lifting. Instruction, quiet.
lines.en: Low and slow. Everything they left is a sentence.
lines.es: Bajo y despacio. Todo lo que dejaron es una frase.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M2 outro, shot 1, the two camps side by side.
lines.en: The old group knows the terrain.
lines.es: El grupo viejo conoce el terreno.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 14.
lines.en: The new group knows the old group.
lines.es: El grupo nuevo conoce al grupo viejo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Shot 2.
lines.en: But they're not living together.
lines.es: Pero no viven juntos.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After 16.
lines.en: So?
lines.es: ¿Y entonces?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: After 17. Thinking it through.
lines.en: So maybe we've been looking for one organization that stopped being one organization.
lines.es: Entonces quizás estuvimos buscando una organización que dejó de ser una sola organización.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Shot 3, the alert on another screen.
lines.en: Command, priority traffic.
lines.es: Comando, tráfico prioritario.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Shot 4, the map zooms to the post.
lines.en: That's my sector.
lines.es: Ese es mi sector.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: After 20.
lines.en: How many?
lines.es: ¿Cuántos?

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: After 21.
lines.en: Twelve.
lines.es: Doce.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Shot 5, to the player's station. One word.
lines.en: Launch.
lines.es: Despeguen.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 A, the family unloading at the farmhouse, classified CIVILIAN. Quiet, a reason.
lines.en: This is why we watch.
lines.es: Por esto miramos.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 B, the police motorcycle at the post's checkpoint. Relief.
lines.en: That's one of ours.
lines.es: Ese es de los nuestros.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 D's second observation stop, radio seen.
lines.en: Behavior matches the warning network.
lines.es: El comportamiento coincide con la red de alerta.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s1-pattern. Pushing.
lines.en: Enough?
lines.es: ¿Alcanza?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s1-enough. Flat.
lines.en: No.
lines.es: No.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 D meets the courier from Mission 2.
lines.en: We have historical correlation.
lines.es: Tenemos correlación histórica.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s1-corr.
lines.en: Say it.
lines.es: Dígalo.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s1-sayit; D becomes HOSTILE CONFIRMED.
lines.en: Confirmed Column contact.
lines.es: Contacto de la Columna confirmado.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 the concealed pair moves on the gate, long objects raised.
lines.en: We have contact.
lines.es: Tenemos contacto.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s2-contact; card CONFIRM IDENTIFICATION. A question to the pilot.
lines.en: Pilot?
lines.es: ¿Piloto?

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 CONFIRM IDENTIFICATION on the right contact. One word.
lines.en: Cleared.
lines.es: Autorizado.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 the strike's end. No celebration.
lines.en: Threat's stopped.
lines.es: Amenaza neutralizada.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s2-stopped.
lines.en: Continue observing.
lines.es: Sigan observando.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 the pair unwatched near the post.
lines.en: They're closing on the post. I need eyes on the tree line.
lines.es: Se acercan al puesto. Necesito ojos en la línea de árboles.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 CONFIRM IDENTIFICATION before the hostile action.
lines.en: We don't have that yet.
lines.es: Todavía no tenemos eso.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 three look alike pickups leave the post.
lines.en: Same chassis. Same heat. Same road.
lines.es: Mismo chasis. Mismo calor. Mismo camino.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s3-chassis.
lines.en: Different answers.
lines.es: Respuestas distintas.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 a strike on a civilian pickup.
lines.en: There were people in that one. Stop.
lines.es: Había gente en esa. Paren.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s3-error.
lines.en: Nobody engages anything else without my word.
lines.es: Nadie ataca nada más sin mi palabra.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the forward feed degrades past the ridge.
lines.en: You're losing the forward feed.
lines.es: Están perdiendo la señal de adelante.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-losing; card RESTORE DRONE NETWORK LINK.
lines.en: Keep another aircraft where the network can still see both sides.
lines.es: Mantengan otra aeronave donde la red todavía vea los dos lados.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-both. Dry.
lines.en: In normal language?
lines.es: ¿En idioma normal?

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-normal. Patient.
lines.en: Put one drone where it can talk to the other drone.
lines.es: Pongan un dron donde pueda hablar con el otro dron.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-talk. A small smile.
lines.en: See? You can do it.
lines.es: ¿Ve? Usted puede.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the relay held in its volume.
lines.en: Forward feed stable.
lines.es: Señal de adelante estable.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 three command site items captured.
lines.en: This isn't random movement.
lines.es: Esto no es movimiento al azar.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-random.
lines.en: Command position?
lines.es: ¿Puesto de mando?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s4-command; card COORDINATED ACTIVITY CONFIRMED.
lines.en: Temporary, maybe.
lines.es: Temporal, quizás.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the unknown quad appears.
lines.en: Hold.
lines.es: Esperen.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-hold.
lines.en: Unidentified aircraft.
lines.es: Aeronave no identificada.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-unid.
lines.en: Civilian?
lines.es: ¿Civil?

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-civ.
lines.en: Not broadcasting anything I recognize.
lines.es: No transmite nada que yo reconozca.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 the quad watches the friendly position.
lines.en: That's theirs.
lines.es: Ese es de ellos.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-theirs.
lines.en: We don't know that.
lines.es: Eso no lo sabemos.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the quad repositions to keep watching.
lines.en: Now I'm comfortable guessing.
lines.es: Ahora sí me animo a adivinar.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the quad intercepted.
lines.en: It's down. It saw enough to come back.
lines.es: Cayó. Vio lo suficiente para volver.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the quad left after its full watch.
lines.en: It's gone. It saw everything it wanted.
lines.es: Se fue. Vio todo lo que quería.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 the northern vehicle turns north.
lines.en: That's wrong.
lines.es: Eso está mal.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-wrong.
lines.en: What?
lines.es: ¿Qué?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-what.
lines.en: Direction.
lines.es: La dirección.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the vehicle near the northern exit.
lines.en: You're at the edge of coverage.
lines.es: Están en el borde de la cobertura.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 after s5-edge. An order.
lines.en: Do not follow beyond boundary.
lines.es: No lo sigan más allá del límite.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 a TRACKER given a contact; TRACKER only.
lines.en: That one's yours. Watch it until it tells you what it is.
lines.es: Ese es suyo. Mírenlo hasta que les diga qué es.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the RELAY role's volume shown; RELAY only.
lines.en: That box is where you live now. Don't leave it.
lines.es: Ese recuadro es su casa ahora. No lo dejen.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 the strike role cleared; STRIKE only.
lines.en: You're the one they'll call. Not before.
lines.es: A ustedes los van a llamar. No antes.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 the interceptor role opens; INTERCEPTOR only.
lines.en: Small, slow, curious. Stay on it.
lines.es: Chico, lento, curioso. No lo suelten.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Five contacts around the post. Watch each until it tells you what it is.
lines.es: Cinco contactos alrededor del puesto. Miren cada uno hasta que les diga qué es.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Nothing for you yet. Help them watch.
lines.es: Todavía nada para ustedes. Ayuden a mirar.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: The tree line round the post. Find who is still there.
lines.es: La línea de árboles alrededor del puesto. Encuentren quién sigue ahí.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Hold near the gate. You go when Vega clears it.
lines.es: Esperen cerca del portón. Van cuando Vega autorice.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Three pickups. Stay on each until it shows you something.
lines.es: Tres camionetas. Sigan cada una hasta que les muestre algo.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: The relay goes in the box first. Then the command site.
lines.es: Primero el relé en el recuadro. Después el puesto de mando.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Into the box and stay there.
lines.es: Al recuadro, y quédense ahí.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Radio, shelter, motorcycles, the markers on the route.
lines.es: Radio, refugio, motos, las marcas en el camino.

lines.speaker: ibarra-guide
lines.notes: Interior M3 guide brief.
lines.en: Stay on it. Do not cross the line.
lines.es: No lo suelten. No crucen la línea.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, shot 1, the post marked on the BOARD. A report, tired.
lines.en: Post has intermittent communications.
lines.es: El puesto tiene comunicaciones intermitentes.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, shot 2, the post. A question that wants a yes or no.
lines.en: Hostiles confirmed?
lines.es: ¿Hostiles confirmados?

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 2.
lines.en: No.
lines.es: No.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 3. A correction, not a rebuke.
lines.en: Then don't call them hostiles.
lines.es: Entonces no los llame hostiles.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, shot 3, UNKNOWN populating round the post.
lines.en: Fine. Armed individuals reported near the perimeter.
lines.es: Bueno. Se reportan individuos armados cerca del perímetro.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 5. Dry.
lines.en: That description applies to half the region.
lines.es: Esa descripción vale para media región.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 6. Settling it.
lines.en: Pilot builds the picture.
lines.es: El piloto arma el cuadro.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, shot 4, the mantra, one word a dot.
lines.en: Find.
lines.es: Encuentren.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 8.
lines.en: Follow.
lines.es: Sigan.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 9.
lines.en: Identify.
lines.es: Identifiquen.

lines.speaker: vega
lines.notes: Interior M3 intro film, after 10, the longer pause.
lines.en: Then we decide what happens.
lines.es: Después decidimos qué pasa.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, outro shot 1, the northern vehicle's still. Sure.
lines.en: Column supply vehicle.
lines.es: Vehículo de abastecimiento de la Columna.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, after 12. Quiet doubt.
lines.en: I don't think so.
lines.es: No creo.

lines.speaker: rojas
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, after 13.
lines.en: Why?
lines.es: ¿Por qué?

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, outro shot 2, the zoom into the containers.
lines.en: Because these people have spent years surviving with almost nothing.
lines.es: Porque esta gente pasó años sobreviviendo casi sin nada.

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, outro shot 3, another still of the vehicle. Trailing off.
lines.en: Whoever supplied that...
lines.es: Quien sea que les dio eso...

lines.speaker: ibarra
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, after 16, the beat. Low.
lines.en: ...has money.
lines.es: ...tiene plata.

lines.speaker: ferrer
lines.notes: Interior M3 outro film, after 17, only if the unknown drone completed its watch.
lines.en: And the drone that watched the post got everything it came for.
lines.es: Y el dron que vigiló el puesto se llevó todo lo que vino a buscar.
